title: Exactness of normalized module stalks
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe, J a Grothendieck topology, R a sheaf of commutative rings, p a point of Sh(C,J), and s a normalized ringed-site point [def-sfb-ringed-site-point], with stalk ring A and module functor S. Then S is exact as a functor between abelian categories.

source.place: Tag 05V3; exactness of module inverse image

proof.text: Underlying set sheaves create finite limits of modules; inverse image preserves finite limits. The prescribed underlying natural isomorphism and reflection by forgetting module structure therefore show S preserves finite limits.

The module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetful functor preserves finite colimits. Thus module epis become locally surjective maps of underlying set sheaves. The point inverse image preserves epis as a left adjoint; the underlying natural isomorphism and module forgetful reflection make S preserve epis. Additivity, kernels and epis imply exactness.
